Its milder entry, "Democrats Are Still Figuring Out That 'Normal' Can't Be Taught," treats Democratic strategic struggles as an inherent and almost comic deficiency, with "Normal Can't Be Taught" implying the party is constitutionally incapable of political competence. Its more charged headline — "Leftists Will Never Self-Reflect, And They Will Never Apologize For The Horrors They Inflict" — abandons news framing entirely, using the pejorative "Leftists," absolute language ("will never"), and the morally extreme phrase "Horrors They Inflict" to cast the left as both intransigent and actively harmful.
